defs.def: the point when sb/sth is best, most successful, strongest, etc. 顶峰；高峰

ex.s: The average peak workload was measured at 103 watts.
ex.t: 平均峰值工作负荷测量值为103瓦特。

ex.s: A total of 92 women were in the medium fitness category; and 59 women were in the low fitness category, defined as a peak workload of 80 watts or less, or having their exercise tests stopped because of high blood pressure, chest pain or other cardiovascular problems.
ex.t: 共有92名女性处于中等健康类别；59名女性处于低健康类别，定义为峰值工作负荷80瓦特或以下，或因高血压、胸痛或其他心血管问题而停止运动测试。

defs.def: the pointed top of a mountain; a mountain with a pointed top 山峰；峰峦

ex.s: The peak of Mount Qomolangma, 8,849 meters above sea level.
ex.t: 珠穆朗玛峰峰顶，海拔8849米。

ex.s: In Peru, local farmers around a mountain with a glacier that has already fallen victim to climate change have begun painting the entire mountain peak white in the hope that the added reflectiveness will restore the life-giving ice.
ex.t: 在秘鲁，当地农民在一座冰川已经成为气候变化受害者的山脉周围开始把整个山峰涂成白色，希望增加的反射率能够恢复赋予生命的冰雪。

ex.s: In addition to seeing spectacular mountain peaks and forests, one highlight of their trip was being able to see many different creatures, including deer, mountain goats, and even a grizzly bear and an eagle.
ex.t: 除了看到壮观的山峰和森林，他们旅行的一个亮点是能够看到许多不同的生物，包括鹿、山羊，甚至还有一只灰熊和一只鹰。

defs.def: any narrow and pointed shape, edge, etc. 尖形；尖端；尖头

ex.s: The painting of Apsaras reached a peak during the Tang Dynasty; these images are full of life, reflecting the confidence and optimism of people from that time.
ex.t: 飞天画像在唐代达到了顶峰；这些形象充满生机，反映了那个时代人们的自信和乐观。

ex.s: By 700 AD, Maya civilisation was at its peak.
ex.t: 到公元700年，玛雅文明达到鼎盛。

ex.s: Background information The Ancient Maya civilisation reached its peak between 250 AD and 900 AD.
ex.t: 背景信息 古代玛雅文明在公元250年至公元900年间达到顶峰。

ex.s: Be careful, however, not to go to popular islands during peak season, unless you want to (wrestle) with other tourists!
ex.t: 不过要注意，不要在旺季去热门岛屿，除非你想和其他游客（拥挤争抢）！

defs.def: the stiff front part of a cap that sticks out above your eyes 帽舌；帽檐
